EVAL-F-003-S1.title: Define External Research Link Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-003-S1.description: Define structured schema for external provider research links including source (Healthgrades, NPI Registry, state board), URL, label, and guidance text for user interpretation.

EVAL-F-003-S2.title: Implement Research Link Generation Logic
EVAL-F-003-S2.description: Implement backend logic to construct external research URLs dynamically using provider NPI and state, including Healthgrades, CMS NPI Registry, and supported state medical boards. Include source-specific labeling and guidance text explaining how users should interpret each link (e.g., ratings vs licensure verification). Handle unsupported states gracefully.

EVAL-F-003-S3.title: Expose Research Links via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-003-S3.description: Integrate generated research links into provider detail response and expose them through evaluate_care_facade for frontend consumption.

EVAL-F-003-S4.title: Integrate URL Validation for Research Links
EVAL-F-003-S4.description: Validate all generated research URLs using URL guardian pipeline (HEAD check, AI verification, correction) before returning to user.

EVAL-F-003-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Research Links
EVAL-F-003-S5.description: Add tests for link generation correctness, schema validation, URL validation integration, and end-to-end delivery via facade.
